definition_title: Finite quotient interface for the 732 reciprocal-triple gadget
definition:
import Std
import Init.Grind.Ordered.Module
namespace Erdos302Kernel

def inGNat (x : Nat) : Bool :=
 x == 122 || x == 183 || x == 244 || x == 366 || x == 732

def Expected (a b c : Nat) : Prop :=
 (a = 122 ∧ b = 183 ∧ c = 366) ∨
 (a = 183 ∧ b = 244 ∧ c = 732) ∨
 (a = 244 ∧ b = 366 ∧ c = 732)
instance (a b c : Nat) : Decidable (Expected a b c) := by
 unfold Expected
 infer_instance

def quotient (a b : Nat) : Nat := a * b / (b - a)
















end Erdos302Kernel
natural_language_statement:
For natural numbers $a,b$, define the truncated natural quotient $Q(a,b)=ab/(b-a)$. Let $G=\{122,183,244,366,732\}$, and define the expected ordered triples by

$$
\mathcal E=\{(122,183,366),(183,244,732),(244,366,732)\}.
$$

The Boolean gadget membership test, quotient function, expected-triple predicate and its decidability instance form the interface for the kernel-checked finite isolation certificates. The quotient definition itself does not assume a<b; the relevant inequalities are hypotheses of later theorems.
